summary: This is an 8-K filed by Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. to disclose entry into an underwriting agreement for the issuance and sale of $1.05 billion aggregate principal amount of 8.875% Senior Notes due 2032. The notes were sold via a shelf registration (Form S-3) and are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by certain subsidiaries. The offering closed on June 4, 2026. Terms include optional redemption provisions and customary covenants. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
